commands.STATUS: immediate OK followed by key=value pairs
commands.STOP: cancel queued controls, stop excitation, drain and close recording; interrupted recording has no clean footer
commands.REF: queue reference mode at current rate
commands.MEASURE: queue sample mode at current rate
commands.SAVE: persist calibrated factor only while acquisition and recording are stopped
commands.RECORD: open a new file while sample acquisition is running
commands.END: drain, close and flush recording while acquisition may continue
commands.TIME YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS: set RTC in UTC, years 2000 through 2099

control.queued_response: OK queued means accepted, not completed; inspect STATUS

status_units.utc_date: YYYYMMDD numeric; use only when rtc_valid=1
status_units.utc_time: HHMMSS numeric; use only when rtc_valid=1
status_units.power_status: 0 idle, 1 waiting for storage/release, 2 Standby returned/debug prevented entry
status_units.config_state: 0 no saved monitoring configuration, 1 usable, 2 saved configuration incompatible
status_units.record_result: latest recording business result, same enum as CDC v2 GET_RECORD; 9 incomplete
status_units.record_phase: 0 accepted, 1 active, 2 terminal; same as CDC v2 GET_RECORD
status_units.record_clean_end: 1 when a valid END footer was written; complete data additionally requires terminal phase, result 0 and unknown_loss 0
status_units.record_unknown_loss: latest recording contains an unquantified loss; same as CDC v2 GET_RECORD

power_policy.wake: PWR button PC5, MEAS button PA0, raw USB PC13; reset restart
power_policy.measurement_button: start 4000 SPS and attempt recording; next press stops and closes recording

adc_error.6: raw acquisition queue full, acquisition stopped

sd_bus_default.reason: safe default speed without implicit CMD6 High Speed negotiation

file.name: DRMS0000.BIN through DRMS9999.BIN, never overwrite

ads_frame.description: four 24-bit words: STAT_1 response, channel1, channel2, CRC16 in upper 16 bits

sequence.description: DRDY edge counter modulo 2^32; gaps expose lost frames

spi_overruns.description: cumulative observed edge overruns for the current START

frame_queue_drops.description: cumulative acquisition queue drops for the current START

file.resistance: scale_ohms * signed24(channel1) / signed24(channel2); invalid CRC/format/fault/saturation must not produce valid resistance
file.status_advisory: F_ADCIN (bit4) alone is retained as advisory because AIN2N is wired to AVSS; other STAT_1 fault bits invalidate the measurement
file.timing: elapsed time is relative to the first recorded sample, from sequence deltas/rate; header RTC is the RECORD request time, not an exact first-sample UTC timestamp
file.clean_end: valid footer and record count match; missing footer means interrupted/unclean file, even if a prefix is recoverable

excitation_guard.meaning: first-board VSET +/-10% and 0.5 V compliance reserve; diagnostic guard, not a current accuracy guarantee

segments.boundary: after a batch; may exceed nominal by one batch, remains below FAT32 file limit
segments.continuity: queue stays enabled while closing/opening segments
segments.metadata: same RECORD request metadata across segments

decoder_exit_status.0: no reported software loss and clean end, or explicit diagnostic recovery requested
